description: Strict mapping of scientific theories to Riverpod state and Flame rendering.

riverpod_state.logic: Calculates Delta Psi between SoilMoistureProvider and VPD.
riverpod_state.data_structure: Updates a pre-allocated Float64List buffer with new water flux values per sub-step.

flame_binding.animation_speed: Particle velocity.length is directly multiplied by Jw (higher transpiration pull = faster movement).
flame_binding.pathing: Water particles (z-index 60) follow bezier curves from soil to root hitbox.
flame_binding.lifecycle: Execute removeFromParent() upon hitting root hitbox, transferring mass to plant internal pool.

riverpod_state.logic: MicrobialEnzymesSolver reads carbon [S] from POM pool and resolves the mineralized N and C output.
riverpod_state.data_structure: Atomic state update decrementing POM and incrementing NH4+ pool.

flame_binding.visual_feedback: Hotspot/microbe cluster (z-index 30) scale and pulse animation intensity is driven by reaction rate V.
flame_binding.particle_spawn: Solver validation triggers world.add() for new NH4+ particles precisely at the hotspot coordinates, respecting max render limits.

riverpod_state.logic: NitrogenCycleSolver monitors local C:N ratio. If N_immob > 0, mineral N is transferred to microbial_biomass_N via atomic transaction.

flame_binding.capture_animation: Physics update(dt) reads isImmobilized flag. If true, free-floating N particles (z-index 60) override root pathing and Lerp towards the nearest microbial hotspot (z-index 20).
flame_binding.lifecycle: Upon collision with hotspot, particle executes removeFromParent().

riverpod_state.logic: Maintains spatial map of nutrient distribution based on Poisson Disk hotspot coordinates and their pool sizes.

flame_binding.growth_direction: Root tip nodes (z-index 50) calculate next coordinate by overriding pure gravity if local grad([N]) is high.
flame_binding.visual_feedback: Root visually curves towards nutrient-rich soil aggregates.

riverpod_state.logic: Every tick validates that N_total remains constant across all pools.

flame_binding.strict_spawn: world.add() is ONLY permitted when source_pool strictly decrements.
flame_binding.strict_despawn: removeFromParent() is ONLY permitted when target hitbox is reached and target_pool strictly increments.
flame_binding.constraint: ZERO ZOMBIE PARTICLES. Visual mass must always equal logical mass.
